name: Create Family
description: Creates a new family. The authenticated user becomes the family head and is automatically added as a member with memberType 'head' and permissions ['*']. A unique familyNumber (BEN-FAM-YYYY-XXXXXX) is auto-generated.

errorResponses.description: Returned when required fields are missing or fail validation
Missing or invalid JWT token

errorResponses.message: You already head a family. A user can only head one family.
errorResponses.description: Returned when the user is already the head of another active family
Returned when an unexpected server error occurs

name: List All Families
description: Retrieves a paginated list of all families (non-deleted). Admin only. Supports search by familyName/familyNumber, filtering by status, lga, ward, and sorting.

search.description: Case-insensitive search on familyName or familyNumber

errorResponses.description: Missing or invalid JWT token

errorResponses.message: User does not have require permission
errorResponses.description: Returned when the user role is not global_admin, admin, or support_admin

name: Get My Family
description: Returns the family the authenticated user is an active member of, together with its members and dependents, and the user's own memberType.

data.family: FamilyDocument (headId populated with firstname, lastname, email, phone)
data.members: FamilyMember[] (userId populated with firstname, lastname, email, phone, passportPhoto; dependentId populated)

errorResponses.description: Missing or invalid JWT token

errorResponses.message: You are not a member of any family
errorResponses.description: Returned when the user has no active family membership

name: Get My Pending Invitations
description: Returns all pending family invitations sent to the authenticated user.

errorResponses.description: Missing or invalid JWT token

name: Get Family by ID
description: Returns a single family by its ID, including its members and dependents.

id.description: The unique identifier of the family (MongoDB ObjectId)

data.members: FamilyMember[] (userId populated with firstname, lastname, email, phone, passportPhoto; dependentId populated)

errorResponses.description: Missing or invalid JWT token

errorResponses.message: Only family head can delete family

name: Invite Member
description: Invites an existing registered user (by email) to join the family. Creates a FamilyInvitation with a token valid for 7 days, sends an email with accept/reject links, creates a system notification for the receiver, and logs an audit entry.

id.description: The unique identifier of the family (MongoDB ObjectId)

requestPayload.receiverEmail: string (required) - Email of the user to invite

validation: RelationshipType values: husband, wife, father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister, guardian, ward, grandfather, grandmother, grandson, granddaughter, uncle, aunt, cousin, other

errorResponses.description: Returned when required fields are missing or relationship is invalid
Missing or invalid JWT token

errorResponses.message: Only family head can invite members
errorResponses.description: Returned when the authenticated user is not the family head or an admin

errorResponses.message: User with this email not found
errorResponses.description: Returned when no registered user exists with the given email

errorResponses.message: User is already a member of this family
errorResponses.description: Returned when the invited user is already a family member

errorResponses.message: An invitation has already been sent to this user
errorResponses.description: Returned when a pending invitation already exists for the user

name: Accept Invitation (Public)
description: Public endpoint. Accepts a family invitation using the token from the email link. Adds the receiver as an active adult member, notifies the sender, and logs an audit entry.

token.description: The invitation token from the email link

errorResponses.description: Returned when the invitation is past its expiresAt date

errorResponses.message: Invitation not found or already responded to
errorResponses.description: Returned when the token is invalid or the invitation is no longer pending

name: Reject Invitation (Public)
description: Public endpoint. Rejects a family invitation using the token from the email link. Marks the invitation as rejected and logs an audit entry.

token.description: The invitation token from the email link

errorResponses.message: Invitation not found or already responded to
errorResponses.description: Returned when the token is invalid or the invitation is no longer pending

name: Add Member
description: Adds an existing user (by userId) directly as an adult member of the family, without an invitation. Only the family head (or an admin) can add members.

id.description: The unique identifier of the family (MongoDB ObjectId)

requestPayload.userId: string (required) - The user ID of the member to add

name: Transfer Headship
description: Transfers family headship to another active family member. The current head becomes an adult member, and the new head receives full permissions and a system notification.

id.description: The unique identifier of the family (MongoDB ObjectId)
